cohort: 154 patients with PH admitted to the Third Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University between January 2011 and December 2020
finding: The risk of maternal mortality was significantly higher in the severe PH group compared to the mild-moderate group, emphasizing the need for pulmonary artery pressure screening before pregnancy and early multidisciplinary care.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was included as a variable in the model to assess the effect of pulmonary artery systolic pressure on maternal mortality.
